title: Face processing EEG dataset for EEGLAB
description: This dataset is the EEG and structural MRI portion of a multi-subject, multi-modal face processing study (originally ds000117), repackaged in EEGLAB format with augmented event logs and HED annotation. Eighteen participants viewed famous, unfamiliar, and scrambled faces while making symmetry judgments. The original study had two sessions (fMRI and simultaneous MEG/EEG); only the MEEG session's EEG data and the structural MRI are included here, while MEG and fMRI data are excluded. Minimal preprocessing, including EEG channel extraction, event correction, and resampling to 250 Hz, yields a lightweight version suitable for tutorials and EEG source localization.
methods_description: Participants completed two sessions three months apart in the original study, one with fMRI and one with simultaneous MEG/EEG; only the MEEG session is included in this dataset. In each session they responded with a key press to photographs of famous, unfamiliar, and scrambled faces, judging relative facial symmetry. Each face was presented twice, with the repeat either immediate or delayed by 5-15 presentations. EEG channels were extracted from the MEG/EEG fif files, fiducials added, events extracted and corrected (34 ms shift), data resampled to 250 Hz, runs 1-6 merged, and the result saved as EEGLAB .set. The repackaging, event log augmentation, and HED annotation were carried out by the data curators Ramon Martinez, Dung Truong, Scott Makeig, and Arnaud Delorme (UCSD, La Jolla, CA, USA). The curators are credited here rather than in the author list, which reflects the original dataset authors (Wakeman and Henson) as given in the BIDS dataset_description.json.
